draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.40, the 32nd-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 2nd of 32 at CB. He went 33rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Brent Grimes. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (9th percentile), broad jump (16th percentile). College production: 13 passes defended in 2018, 5th of 28 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 8 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 104 career games and 96 starts over 7 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 9 AV in 2025 against a career-best 11 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 97.8% (98th percentile), approximate value 9 (96th percentile), interceptions 2 (82nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-7 cornerback who played: 97.8% season snap share against a median of 46.8%, above the norm.
